The excess fare ticket books are issued in two types: local EFT books for use within the home railway and foreign EFT books for inter-railway journeys. A TTE is issued one of each type at a time. The distinction keeps accounting of local and through collections separate. This provision exists for a practical reason in day-to-day railway working; keeping that practical picture in mind makes the fact far easier to retain than memorising it in isolation.

q: what is the minimum amount of excess fare levied for travelling without ticket
e: The excess charge under Section 138 now carries a floor of Rs 500 (excess charge equal to the amount payable, or Rs 500, or the charges notified by the Central Government, whichever is more). q: Which of the following is correct

e: The correct answer is (a) and (b) above.
